title: LangChain Repository Overview
summary: LangChain is a framework for developing applications powered by large language models (LLMs). It simplifies the orchestration of LLMs with external components like data sources, tools, and memory, enabling the creation of complex, context-aware, and agentic AI systems. Developers use it to build, deploy, and evaluate intelligent applications that go beyond simple LLM calls.

nodes.label: Developer / User
nodes.title: Human User
nodes.description: A developer or end-user interacting with or building applications using the LangChain framework, designing and running AI systems.

nodes.label: Core Framework & Utilities
nodes.title: LangChain Core Framework
nodes.description: Provides the foundational interfaces, base abstractions, and essential utilities for building all LangChain components and applications, ensuring consistency and extensibility.

nodes.label: Language Model Interaction
nodes.title: LLM & Chat Model Interfaces
nodes.description: Defines how to interact with various language models, including standardized message formats, prompt engineering techniques, and structured output parsing for diverse LLM providers.

nodes.label: Agent & Chain Orchestration
nodes.title: Complex Workflow Orchestration
nodes.description: Enables building sophisticated multi-step applications by composing LLMs, tools, and data sources into intelligent agents and sequential chains, managing conversational memory and execution flow.

nodes.label: Data Management & Retrieval
nodes.title: Document & Knowledge Management
nodes.description: Provides tools for loading, indexing, storing, and retrieving documents from various sources, crucial for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) applications and maintaining external knowledge bases.

nodes.label: Developer Tools & Integrations
nodes.title: Ecosystem & Development Support
nodes.description: Offers a suite of tools for evaluation, testing, partner integrations, agent middleware, and general utilities to support the entire development lifecycle of LangChain applications.

groups.label: Core Foundations
groups.title: LangChain Core Foundations
groups.description: This group encompasses the fundamental building blocks, abstract interfaces, and essential utilities that form the architectural backbone of the entire LangChain ecosystem.

groups.label: AI Logic & Orchestration
groups.title: AI Logic & Workflow Orchestration
groups.description: This group focuses on defining how to interact with language models, engineer prompts, and orchestrate complex, multi-step AI workflows using agents and chains.

groups.label: Data & Knowledge Management
groups.title: Data & Knowledge Management
groups.description: This group provides comprehensive tools for loading, indexing, storing, and retrieving documents, enabling applications to access and utilize external knowledge efficiently.

groups.label: Development & Ecosystem Support
groups.title: Development & Ecosystem Support
groups.description: This group offers a suite of tools for evaluating, testing, integrating with external partners, and enhancing agent behavior, supporting the full development lifecycle of LangChain applications.
